title: cdk-construct-ses examples (all languages)
description:
Create runnable examples in packages/cdk-construct-ses/examples/.

Scenarios:
- minimal/ — zoneId + zoneName from bridge fixture, defaults
- with-dkim/ — verifyDkim:true (divergent: adds DKIM DNS records)
- with-iam-group/ — sesGroupEnabled:true (divergent: adds IAM group)
- with-user-access-key/ — sesUserEnabled + createIamAccessKey (divergent: adds IAM user + access key)
- comprehensive/ — all props

All 5 languages. Assertion tests in test/ses-examples.test.ts.
